area.sourceLabel: Arlington On-Demand page and service area shapefile (agency-supplied)
area.bookingInfo: Book in the Arlington Transportation app or call 817-784-7382.
area.tripRules: Trips can start and end anywhere in the zone, or at TRE CentrePort Station outside it.

Arlington.serviceHours: Monday to Friday 6 a.m. to 9 p.m.; Saturday 9 a.m. to 9 p.m.

notes: Zone from the shapefile the City of Arlington sent Atlas Outreach on 2026-11-23 (CIV-2211), 'Arlington On Demand Service Area.zip' (saved unchanged in _reports/agency-files/arlington-on-demand/): two shapes, 'Arlington On-Demand Service Area Boundary' (99.97 sq mi in the file, with one hole) and 'TRE CentrePort Station' (0.05 sq mi), reprojected from NAD83 Texas North Central (US feet) and kept as one zone. The City's page: the service 'covers the entire City of Arlington, the CentrePort TRE Station, and the Eastchase Parkway area in Fort Worth'; the boundary reaches west of the city line south of about 32.73 N, which is the Eastchase Parkway area. Hours and booking from the page; Sunday is not stated, so no Sunday hours; holiday changes are announced in advance. Fares are by distance ($3 under 4 miles to $8 over 8 miles; $3 to or from CentrePort). Arlington has no fixed-route bus agency in Atlas, so this is an on-demand-only agency.
